speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
title: Fruit to Make One Happy
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Gary E. Stevenson spoke about “Fruit to Make One Happy”.

quotes.text: I have come to expect something when I am on the Lord’s errand. Why? Because it happens every time I travel. I meet remarkable, extraordinary people, Latter-day Saints and friends. I am always impressed with children I meet. Primary children! Everywhere, most recently in Australia, New Caledonia, Samoa, Colombia, and Peru. Sometimes you even draw our pictures, and you always improve how I look!
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When I was young like you, I loved fruit—and our family tradition of buying fresh fruit from farm stands during harvest. One stand was known for its delicious peaches. They were so sweet and juicy. Somehow, apples, cherries, and apricots bought from the farmer where they were grown seemed sweeter. Here I am with my dad next to a fruit display. Even today I love seeing and tasting delicious and unique fruits from your countries.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The tree stands for the love of God, including the greatest manifestations of that love: the birth, life, and atoning sacrifice of Jesus Christ. The fruit symbolizes blessings received through the Atonement of Jesus Christ, including ordinances, covenants, and truths of the restored gospel and ultimately eternal life.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: First, we are children of a loving Heavenly Father. Latter-day Saints know that we “once lived with Heavenly Father, who knows everything and loves everyone.” We are His children. Heavenly Father knows us personally. This is your most important identity. “He wants you to be like Him! He gave you a body, abilities, and spiritual gifts. He wants you and all of His children to discover and develop these gifts. He gave us a plan to help us be happy and bless others.” Having this knowledge makes us stronger. This knowledge also makes us kinder to others, knowing that everyone around us is our brother or sister.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We shared with him that the spirits of all men and women, when they pass away, “are taken home to that God who gave them life” and that in God’s loving plan for His children, the spirit of this man’s beloved wife, an honorable woman, was received into a place called the spirit world, where she could enter a state of rest, happiness, and peace. His countenance changed in that moment. It was as if we watched him partake of the fruit of the tree of life and his soul was filled “with exceedingly great joy.” We witnessed a miraculous transformation: peace for despair, joy for sadness, hope for ashes.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We know through revelation the Holy Ghost “is a personage of Spirit” and a member of the Godhead. His very important roles include to warn, to comfort, and to testify. A Primary song you often sing, “I Know My Father Lives,” teaches this: “I know my Father lives and loves me too. The Spirit whispers this to me and tells me it is true, and tells me it is true.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: To my young friends, you have been exceptionally good listeners as I illustrated three delicious fruits of the gospel: we are children of a loving Heavenly Father, the great plan of happiness through Jesus Christ, and the gift of the Holy Ghost.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I close with my testimony of God the Father, Jesus Christ, and the Holy Ghost and of Jesus Christ as our Savior and Redeemer. In the name of Jesus Christ, amen.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
